instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Crest Corporation operates as a micro multi-brand online marketplace, aggregating over 300 independent Portuguese artisan brands across diverse niches like fashion and gourmet food. We utilize a dropship and centralized logistics model to manage fulfillment for top sellers while maintaining high product variety. This structure is currently constrained by a single operational location and minimal internal management layers.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully implemented a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter, which significantly reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days through better workflow automation. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded via this process are 22 points higher than the legacy manual system, demonstrating early success in optimizing customer experience.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated a focus on improving EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within three years through rigorous cost-driver analysis. This requires adopting disciplined, data-driven process improvements to eliminate systemic inefficiencies and reduce operational overhead.
answers.additionalContext: We are six months away from our Series B fundraising round and need a compelling innovation roadmap to show investors. The board requires demonstrable progress on at least one major efficiency initiative before the roadshow begins, making speed and measurable traction critical.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Automated Inventory Risk Forecasting Engine
opportunities.rationale: Given the 'efficiency' priority and high regulatory scrutiny, implementing a basic AI engine to forecast inventory needs per artisan category can drastically reduce holding costs and prevent stockouts. This incremental step addresses immediate margin concerns without requiring heavy infrastructure.

first_actions: Pilot a basic predictive model using historical sales data from the last 12 months.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Integration with existing ERP/Inventory system upgrade time (4 weeks)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in inventory carrying costs by 8% within six months.
milestones: Q3: Data pipeline established and model trained.
Q4: Pilot deployment on 5 high-volume artisan categories.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Hyper-Localized Dynamic Pricing
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging digital maturity to deploy an AI engine that adjusts product pricing in real-time based on competitor activity, local demand spikes, and current regulatory compliance zones. This radical move aims to maximize margin instantly while minimizing manual intervention.

first_actions: Define specific geographic test market for initial deployment (e.g., one region).
Develop a minimal viable pricing API integration.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Cloud infrastructure costs for AI processing ($20k/year)
Minimal software development sprint team allocation (internal founder focus)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 3% higher average gross margin on high-demand artisan products.
milestones: Q1: Alpha testing and model refinement.
Q2: Full deployment in the pilot region.

next_steps.action: Formalize a dedicated process mapping and operational bottleneck audit for the supply chain.
Develop detailed business case and technical specification for the AI-Driven Dynamic Pricing engine pilot.

key_weaknesses: Extreme reliance on single founder knowledge, creating a severe bottleneck for high-level strategic decisions and specialized technical evaluation.
Lack of formal engineering structure, leading to slow execution speed and inconsistent quality in digital initiatives.
Budget constraint (14%) severely limits ability to invest in necessary scalable infrastructure or robust regulatory compliance systems.
Limited technological maturity (Level 2) restricts the organization's ability to leverage advanced automation tools needed for significant efficiency gains.
